column1: # Release titles and what each profile must do with them; tests/scores checks
# every row. Columns, tab-separated: kind, service, profile, title.
#   block:score    the score falls below the profile's minimum, whatever the
#   block:quality  the parsed quality is one the profile leaves off
#   allow          the score reaches the minimum, in a quality the profile
#   ladder:NAME    allow, and rows sharing NAME, service and profile score
#                  strictly lower in the order listed — best first
# Each block kind checks one reason, so a title blocked both ways takes a row
# of each. A title whose quality parses to nothing or to Unknown fails, whatever
# its kind. Titles are realistic shapes, not real releases; each varies one
# ── Radarr: what the hardware cannot play ──────────────────────────────────
# ── Radarr: remuxes, by quality — the profiles leave them off ──────────────
# ── Radarr: audio, flat across both profiles ───────────────────────────────
# ── Radarr: HDR in UHD — DV with fallback over HDR10+ over HDR10 over SDR ──
# ── Radarr: release groups — Bluray tiers above WEB tiers above the rest ───
# ── Radarr: suspect releases, penalized alike in HD and UHD ────────────────
# ── Radarr: LQ groups, penalized harder in UHD ─────────────────────────────
# ── Radarr: HD x265 with no HDR gets in only with DD+ ──────────────────────
# ── Sonarr: what the hardware cannot play ──────────────────────────────────
# ── Sonarr: suspect releases, penalized as in Radarr ───────────────────────
# ── Sonarr: LQ groups, penalized harder in UHD ─────────────────────────────
# ── Sonarr: HD x265 with no HDR gets in with DD or better ──────────────────
